name: lst-gov-platform
description: 辽宁省政务服务移动中台系统 - 辽事通

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env NODE_ENV=development ts-node -r dotenv/config backend/src/index.ts dotenv_config_path=.env
scripts.start:backend: cross-env NODE_ENV=production ts-node -r dotenv/config backend/src/index.ts dotenv_config_path=.env
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
